tex_content.html:
Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0060, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0061 1. Lemma 2.32\group neckpinch

If $|\psi _s|\le 1$ and $R>0$ initially, then the smallest neck radius satisfies \[ (n-1)(T-t)\le r_{\min }(t)^2\le 2(n-1)(T-t), \] so the solution must become singular by time $r_{\min }(0)^2/(n-1)$ unless it loses all necks first.
